a.lede: The Bureau of Industry and Security has announced a new interim final rule to ensure restrictions on the export of physical AI hardware cannot be bypassed by accessing it remotely in data centers around the world.
a.title: New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure

b.lede: Trump bets China won’t mind US blocking remote access to AI chips.
b.title: US moves to cut China’s remote access to AI chips
